title: RPG Maker MV - no weapon charakter animation

posts.author: hunorh92
posts.body:
Hello everyone!  How can these settings be configured in RPG Maker MV:
If the characters have no weapons equipped, their animation should be different.
Allow the animation to be customized for each character when they are without a weapon.
These worked in RPG Maker 2000, but they don’t work automatically in MV—I assume they need scripting.
